Is it worth it to spring for the $60 version that does hot and cold?

That's a great question! So, I have the cold only version, so my answer is based on not knowing what the hot stream is like.

The cold water doesn't feel cold when you use it. It's difficult to describe, but it's more like a refreshing cool feeling. It serves my purposes perfectly. I was concerned at first that it would be too cold, but I am satisfied with the temperature.

The warm water one has some drawbacks too; the installation is more complicated and depending on your bathroom's setup you may have to make changes. My sink's hot water line is enclosed in a cabinet which would mean drilling a hole and you'd be able to see the line from the toilet to the sink. Cold only hooks right to the toilet supply line, so it is much more self contained.

I don't think it's worth it to go for both hot and cold for me right now, but depending on your bathroom it might be worth it.
